title: Verify: Loader and reference validator unit tests
summary: Tests for loadWorld and validateWorld with invalid fixtures
description: Test loader and validator using temp directories and in-memory objects.
acceptance_criteria: Given invalid fixtures, when validated, then each bad reference produces its error.
Given a missing file, when loaded, then an error names the file.

steps.action: Create fixtures backend/game/tests/fixtures/invalid-world.ts exporting a WorldDef (characters [boy], flags [a]) and a SceneDef containing goto_scene 'nowhere', say by 'ghost', set_flag 'zzz', and discover 'nope'; add test in validator.test.ts asserting validateWorld output contains 'unknown scene: nowhere', 'unknown character: ghost', 'unknown flag: zzz', 'unknown object: nope'.
steps.command: cd backend/game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t 'invalid'

steps.action: Add tests that write a minimal world.yaml and scenes/s.yaml to fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()) and assert loadWorld returns scenes.s; and a test with world.yaml listing a missing scene asserting the thrown message contains 's2.yaml'; and a valid-fixture test asserting validateWorld returns [].
steps.command: cd backend/game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t 'loadWorld|valid'
